verdict: Both advisers picked Namecheap + Netlify independently — strong consensus

recommended_path.deploy_method: drag-and-drop folder in browser (no command line needed)

backups.name: Hostinger bundle (~£3/mo first term, domain included)

ross_signup_steps: 2) Use your email + password + UK address (will bill in GBP)
3) After login: search bar → type qsbtower.co.uk → click "Add to Cart"
4) Checkout (~£8-10 first year). Decline upsells (no privacy guard needed for .co.uk; no email hosting needed)
6) Sign up with email (or your existing GitHub if you have one — easier)
7) After login: click "Add new site" → "Deploy manually"
8) Drag the entire web/shops/ folder onto the browser
9) Netlify gives you a temporary URL like https://random-name.netlify.app — you can browse all 15 shops there immediately
10) In Netlify: Domain settings → Add custom domain → qsbtower.co.uk
11) Netlify shows you 2 DNS records to add. Go back to Namecheap → Domain List → Manage → Advanced DNS → add those records
12) Wait 10 min for DNS to propagate. Done.
ross_action_now: sign up Namecheap + buy qsbtower.co.uk, then sign up Netlify — total ~10 minutes
wren_will_do_after: wire the 15 shop subdomains in Netlify, brand each one, hook Stripe Checkout for first orders
